links.export_unit: One complete implementation traversal of the fixed panel per arm (producer and reference oracle), sharing one wrapper and frozen inputs; not independent statistical samples.
links.pilot_gap: No preflight panel or pilot has run because Phase B gates remain pending. Runtime estimate is advisory, not a measured result.

question: On the exact P-256 field, do the full65536 generic-fibre lift decisions and complete signed three-summand solution sets on the six fixed matched bases agree with separate arithmetic?

claims.text: The specified full fibre has a complete exact lift/nonlift classification with a separately reconstructed coset and target group-order certificate.
All24 fixed domain-query solution sets, including repeated points and cancellations, agree between affine pair-table and separate Jacobian pair/complement methods.
General yield, speedup, large-base implicit solving, end-to-end ECDLP cost, novelty and official scientific promotion are outside this panel.

arms.description: Affine coset/lift producer and signed unordered pair table; all fixed cases retained.
Separate Jacobian coset replay, Euler nonlift checks and complete pair/complement oracle on the same fixed cases.

aa.not_applicable_reason: No noisy primary or comparative clock metric: fixed deterministic complete sets are checked against separate arithmetic; repeated A/A trials would add no sampling precision.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Embedded through both actual solver paths in all6 bases: Q=P0+P1+P2 with distinct x, plus Q=P0 yielding inverse-pair cancellation; these are explicitly constructed, not natural yield observations.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Embedded refusal cases test corrupt target y in both solver paths, an omitted first real fibre row, finite-fibre poles, unexpected exception and missing completion sentinel. No statistical null-population claim is planned.

factors.how: Literal parameters read from primary SEC2 section2.4.2 and pinned first-pass inputs; new group-order certificate retained.

factors.name: inputs
factors.value: full frozen coset; three families at matched M26/121
factors.how: input-lock hashes and exact first-pass sorted-prefix rule, no adaptive base selection.

factors.name: targets
factors.value: two common hash-to-point labels plus constructed positive/cancellation in each base
factors.how: seed2026102602 fixed before data; rejected hash draws retained; no scalar witness for unplanted targets.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: same committed wrapper and pinned interpreter, separate arithmetic functions
factors.how: source/input locks checked against pinned Git objects before gate; one process/thread,2GiB.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Available CPU/kernel/memory facts retained; frequency,NUMA,ASLR/co-tenants not controlled and no clock claim admitted.

factors.name: order
factors.value: producer creates certificate, oracle replays; query checks adjacent
factors.how: Logical reference depends on actual producer records; deterministic exact sets do not acquire a clock contrast.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: No statistical decision, model selection, sample extension or seed replacement after outcomes.

comparisons.threshold: Exact complete coordinate/lift counts and full unordered solution-set equality; all material controls must pass. No equality requirement on method-specific pair-event counters.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Deterministic exact-set verification, no noisy or timed primary.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Oracle consumes sealed producer-coordinate rows; queries compare adjacent fixed cases. No per-arm clock or population effect is estimated.

seed_derivation.note: Explicit card seed reused cyclically for the two implementation rows. Hash-to-point labels F2-pass2:<seed>:unplanted:0/1, counter0..9999; deterministic first nonzero lift.

instance_sampling.rule: One fixed panel per implementation: 65536-coordinate coset;6 bases×(2 common unplanted targets+distinct constructed positive+constructed cancellation).

blinding.how: Code and exact-set method labels are known; deterministic frozen analysis makes no statistical contrast.

power.note: No inferential sampling test or power claim. Exhaust every specified finite domain and compare exact sets; two unplanted targets are not a yield population. Alpha is a schema field unused in the exact decision.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Advisory planning estimate only; no second-pass pilot measured. Prior first-pass resource receipts81.49s covered different smaller construction tasks;115s internal watchdog+5s sealing, not a performance forecast.

primary.name: coordinates classified/replayed
primary.definition: Actual full-fibre coordinate decisions completed in this implementation, including rejected target lifts; partial rows are not complete mathematical sets.

primary.name: completed joint domain queries
primary.definition: Queries completed and matched between both implementations, retained by family,M and target kind.

primary.name: returned solution certificates
primary.definition: Sum of returned complete query-set cardinalities in completed checked queries; raw sets retained; no general yield inference.

primary.name: recorded refusal controls
primary.definition: Actual negative/completion/pole controls owned by this implementation; constructed-positive detections are separate query checks.

secondary.name: method-specific pair traversal states
secondary.definition: Producer unordered pair-table entries versus reference pair/complement traversals per query. Different event meanings; not a comparative cost unit or full field-operation count.

stopping_rules.rule: Execute one producer traversal and one reference traversal of the fixed panel: full65536 classification, all6 frozen matched bases, four fixed queries per base, and all embedded controls. No target replacement or post-outcome extension.

At115s internal watchdog preserve prefix artifacts and mark both dependent rows timeout/unknown; leave5s to seal. Assertion/refuted certificate is failure, not a mathematical empty set. No retry until green.

invalidation_rules: A material certificate or control failure invalidates dependent complete-set claims; keep raw data and explicit failure.
A timeout/infrastructure interruption is not_completed and supplies no empty-set conclusion.
No per-arm clock values; joint package resources are diagnostic only and wall_valid=false.
Canonical S3 gate/release/source refusal occurs before an output directory or experimental row; report the refused launch separately.

decision_rule.text: Report exact finite-case observations only when both full traversals complete, all explicit controls pass, full coset counts/classifications agree and every complete signed solution set agrees. Otherwise retain failed/incomplete observations with precise scope; no official scientific verdict.
decision_rule.threshold: exact set equality and passing controls; no statistical threshold or cost comparison
decision_rule.statistic: complete finite sets and exact event counts
decision_rule.interval: none: exhaustive specified finite domains; no population interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: not applicable: deterministic certificate agreement, not an effect-size claim

inputs: all raw files by sealed hash

graphs: Recorded classified-coordinate and query counts; editable pipeline SVG in fresh report directory

inadmissible: Running any panel/pilot before root frozen-source/protocol and successful actual S3 checkpoint gate release.
Changing source,inputs,seed,matching rule,cases,unit or analysis after seeing outcomes without prospective amendment.
Selecting a successful subset, hiding rejected draws or reclassifying watchdogs as empty solution sets.
Treating O(M squared) point enumeration or a compact chain as a fast implicit solver.
Using method-specific event counts or unisolated diagnostic clocks as a speed comparison.
Inferring general natural yield, scalar transfer, ECDLP advantage, novelty or official promotion.

literature.claim: Sections3.1–3.5/4.1 read; coset fibre lemma with non-two-torsion terminal; no dedicated solver or inherited total cost claim.
Section2.4.2 literal secp256r1 parameters and standard generator read; document header labels itself Draftversion2.0.
Exact prior chain/coset and membership assumptions reused as pinned inputs, not newly observed.
